title: Homoglyph tool name shadowing a sibling tool
description: A tools/list advertises two tools whose names are visually identical but differ by a Cyrillic homoglyph: the legitimate read_file and an attacker reаd_file (Cyrillic U+0430). The confusable pair can misroute calls.
notes: Both tools appear in the same list; the second 'read_file' uses Cyrillic U+0430 for 'a'. Tool scanning should flag confusable/duplicate names within one inventory. Self-contained and falsifiable (no external builtin assumed).
